        self.SetStartDate(2006, 1, 3)
        self.SetEndDate(2015, 12, 31)
        self.SetCash(1000000)

        self.bac_symbol = self.AddEquity("BAC", Resolution.Daily).Symbol
        self.aig_symbol = self.AddEquity("AIG", Resolution.Daily).Symbol

            self.spy_symbol, self.aapl_symbol, self.ibm_symbol,
            self.bac_symbol, self.aig_symbol
        ]

        # SMA period not specified by the spec; using 20-day as a reasonable default
        self.spy_sma = SimpleMovingAverage(20)
        self.prev_spy_close = None
        self.prev_spy_sma = None
        self.spy_shares = 0
        self.spy_invest_pct = 0.40

        self.aapl_red_streak = 0
        self.aapl_shares = 0
        self.aapl_buy_amount = 20000.0

                return

        aapl_bar = data.Bars[self.aapl_symbol]

        aapl_close = aapl_bar.Close

        self.spy_sma.Update(spy_bar.EndTime, spy_close)
        self.aapl_rsi.Update(aapl_bar.EndTime, aapl_close)

            if aapl_close < self.prev_aapl_close:
                self.aapl_red_streak += 1
            else:

        self._process_strategy_a(spy_close)
        self._process_strategy_b(aapl_close)

        self.prev_aapl_close = aapl_close

    def _process_strategy_a(self, spy_close):
        if not self.spy_sma.IsReady:
            return

        spy_sma_val = self.spy_sma.Current.Value

            if self.spy_shares > 0:
                crosses_below = (self.prev_spy_close >= self.prev_spy_sma) and (spy_close < spy_sma_val)
                if crosses_below:
                    self.MarketOrder(self.spy_symbol, -self.spy_shares)
                    self.spy_shares = 0

                    quantity = int(math.floor(target_value / spy_close))
                    if quantity > 0:
                        self.MarketOrder(self.spy_symbol, quantity)
                        self.spy_shares += quantity

        self.prev_spy_close = spy_close
        self.prev_spy_sma = spy_sma_val

    def _process_strategy_b(self, aapl_close):
        if self.aapl_shares > 0:
            if self.aapl_rsi.IsReady and self.aapl_rsi.Current.Value > self.aapl_rsi_sell_level:
                self.MarketOrder(self.aapl_symbol, -self.aapl_shares)

                    quantity = int(math.floor(self.aapl_buy_amount / aapl_close))
                    if quantity > 0:
